Triage: area, `pm:blocked` and p2 stand as filed; rationale: area:ux · Bug · follow-ups of the cross-currency pick (#36249): no note on a re-pick over a filled cell, an unbounded opening wait, and a record-side gap. Graded non-blocking on the parent PR · size S.

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTM6Q7J3o7taPraVR2

**Item 4, added from the #36351 delta L2 (S5, comment 7081121014), at the seat's request.** A target's currency is read on the line or record as it stood before the pick, so a pick that fills a code field and its amount together withholds the amount.

- Repro: a product has a `currency_code` field and a `unit_price` in `record` mode over it, and the line is shaped the same way. On a fresh line, the grid's same-named copy writes `currency_code`, then judges `unit_price` against a line that holds no code yet. The price is withheld, and the note says no currency is chosen, right beside the code the same pick just wrote. Before #36351 both values copied.
- Where: `gridAutofillCurrency` in `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/grid-field/GridFieldWidget.tsx` gets the row before the patch. `currencyFor` in `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx` reads the record being edited the same way for declared pairs.
- Done when: an amount is judged against the line or record with this pick's own writes to the code field applied, pinned through the grid and through `ObjectForm`.

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

One more item for this card, from PR #36351's delta review on head 9ac9c94c (S7 closed). This is not a defect of #36351: a pick is judged once, at the pick. If a price is copied under USD and the record's code is then changed to EUR in the same edit, the copied price stays. A withheld note also keeps the code it was judged under. This holds on all three hosts, and for a hand-typed price too. When this card bounds the currency rules, decide whether a code change re-judges the filled amounts or shows a note. Also N9: the record-page editor now re-renders on every keystroke in any record field. That is correct and not measured, so measure it if a slowdown shows.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

Addendum for this card's follow-up set (found by the #36321 card thread, PR #36578, measured on its head `b37d813a5`): on a New Invoice whose header currency is still entirely unset, a product picked on a line leaves Unit Price empty with the "no currency is chosen here yet" note. This is the safe direction (no foreign amount is copied into the home currency), and PR #36578 restores the case where the header shows a currency (the picker's trigger now carries its code). Folded here rather than filed alone, as one more "pick before the gate can tell the currency" case; the seat holding this card decides whether it belongs in scope.

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi4PechTRCTBrfxV8W

## Ruled: keep the amounts and note · 2026-11-24T01:08Z

The question raised in comment 7084290758 (in one edit, after the record's currency changes, what happens to amount cells already filled) went to the maintainer as a decision card in the os-support-ai fleet project after an independent contract-tier review. The maintainer (Yibo Wang) picked at 2026-11-24T01:07Z, verbatim: 「保留金额并提示」.

## Ruling

1. Filled amounts are never changed or cleared by a currency change in the same edit.
2. An amount a lookup pick copied in gets a note beside it naming the currency it was copied under and the record's current one (for example "copied as USD 100, the record is now EUR"), in the same voice as the #36249 cross-currency note (ruling 7075336705, 「币种不同就不填并说明」).
3. A withheld-pick note already shown refreshes to the new currency.
4. Hand-typed amounts get no note.

Scope note: once a record has saved child rows following its currency, changing the code is already refused (ADR-0144 D2), so this covers new records, records with no saved lines, lines staged in the same edit, and declared pairs on the record's own amounts. Not taken: clearing pick-copied amounts; leaving it as is.

This is a new item on this card beside items 1–4; seat 3's ux-B area builds items 1–4 first, this item may ride the same PR or follow as `Refs #36412`.

The card stays open for the ruling item and goes back to `pm:queue`. The ux-B claim (7124961299) ends here because the ruling item is p2, and the maintainer's priority ruling (2026-11-24T08:53Z, relayed by the seat) puts ux capacity on the Studio epic #36890 and on area:ux p1 cards.

## ⚠️ Maintainer question first: ask this before building

Ruling 7118795825 (「保留金额并提示」) does not settle one visible case. Suppose a pick's amount was withheld because the currencies differed, and the target is still empty. Then, in the same edit, the record's currency changes to the picked amount's own currency. What should the refreshed withheld note show?
- **A.** Drop the note. The cell stays empty.
- **B.** Keep the note, naming the picked amount and saying the record is now in that currency.
- **C.** Fill the empty cell.

The #36918 dev and ux-B both recommend **B**. It keeps the picked price visible without writing a value the ruling did not order. C goes against the spirit of rule 1.

## What remains: the ruling item, verbatim scope from 7118795825
1. A currency change in the same edit never changes or clears a filled amount.
2. An amount that a lookup pick copied in gets a note naming the currency it was copied under and the record's current currency, in the #36249 note voice (ruling 7075336705).
3. A withheld-pick note that is already shown refreshes to the new currency.
4. A hand-typed amount gets no note.

Scope is bounded by ADR-0144 D2.

## What #36918 left in place for it
- A withheld value now records `held` (what its target held at the pick), and `withheldStillStands` keeps the note while the target still holds that value.
- `judgePickWrites` judges one pick's writes together. `amountCurrencyOf(…, writes)` applies the pick's own code write.
- `useFollowedParentRead` reports none / pending / read / unread. An unread parent withholds with reason `targetCurrencyUnread`.
- L1 nit N1 is open for whoever comes next: the "no parent object" and "answered no row" arms of `unread` have no pin of their own.
- Item 3 was closed by measurement. Every record-form host already stamps (listed in the `recordFormStamp.ts` header). The standalone `form` node in `@object-ui/components` is the one gap, and it went to triage as its own card (mailbox #36743, comment 7127028135).

## Size
Items 1–4 came to 714 lines. Under the per-card 3,000-line rule, this card's PRs together must stay under 3,000, or each of its PRs is Tier H.

No local branch is held. #36918's branch is merged.

**Ruled: B** · 2026-11-25T09:16Z · by the maintainer, in seat repo:objectstack#4's session. Verbatim: 「#37257 B、#37230 A、#37236 B、#36412 B」.

This answers the open question under ruling 7118795825 (「保留金额并提示」, item 3). It concerns a withheld cross-currency pick whose note is already shown, when in the same edit the record's currency changes to the pick's own currency.

- The note stays.
- The cell stays empty. Nothing is filled automatically, which keeps ruling 7118795825 item 1 and the #36249 rule 「币种不同就不填并说明」.
- The note now says the record is in that currency and the pick can be re-picked to fill it. For example: "the record is now USD; pick again to fill USD 100".
- A hand-typed amount still gets no note.

With items 1–4 landed by #36918, this is the last open item on the card. It is ready for dispatch and goes to zone a4-C.
